name: Compute Cluster S27: Percent Scaling
description: Tests: PercentFormat multiplies raw by 100. Pass raw decimal (0.456) to display as 45.6%. Use DecimalFormat for pre-scaled values.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S27: Percent Scaling
# PercentFormat multiplies raw by 100. Pass raw decimal (0.456) -> displays "45.6%".
# DecimalFormat for pre-scaled values.
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
ret = returns(close)
cum_ret = returns(close, type=ReturnsType.cumulative)
vol = volatility(close, method=VolMethod.annualized, period=21)

# Summary table showing percent-scaled metrics
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Formatting',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Return Metrics (PercentFormat)',
      row_size=1, col_size=3,
      col_headers=['Cumulative Return', 'Volatility', 'Daily Return'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
      ])
)(cum_ret, vol, ret)
